description: Seven newly selected public subjects for the third-period experiment; sources and caveats recorded before evaluating the new rule. No user case is included.
selectionNotes: These public-figure cases are a convenience sample, dominated by entertainment and family events. None was included in the earlier Nadi public, v1, v2, v3 or rectification fixtures. No original birth document was inspected by this project.
Date-only events use local noon. When an event's location is not verified, the recorded zone is an explicitly noted approximation rather than a claim of the actual birthplace or ceremony time.

F. Scott Fitzgerald's baby-book time is 15:30; Astro-Databank interprets it as local mean time. Whether that is the correct civil time basis in 1896 is uncertain, so the evaluator also checks zone-database time as a sensitivity.

Guilherme Berenguer's son Sebastian was omitted: some later biographies give 22 May 2013, but contemporaneous UOL and Globo reports say the announcement did not state the birth day. Julianne Moore's daughter was omitted because sources conflict on the date.

Audrey Hepburn's first civil and religious wedding dates are reported as 24 and 25 September 1954 in different sources. We use the reported religious ceremony on 25 September, never both as independent events. Olivier Sarkozy's 1997 French ceremony is distinct from an earlier Nantucket legal wedding; the 2008 job date is a reported appointment/announcement, not a verified first day of work.

Subjects are drawn from varied places and occupations, but seven public biographies and related family events cannot establish population accuracy. Olivier Sarkozy is the half-brother of a subject in the reused v3 cohort; analyse cohorts separately.
